people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
translations.bsb: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
translations.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
translations.asv: The Jews answered and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a demon?
